metadata.title: AI Telemetry and Observability

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for observing, recording, and correlating AI system behavior, decisions, and actions to support accountability, detection, and response.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: AI telemetry, observability, behavioral logging, and cross-agent correlation systems.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern defining how AI inputs, outputs, decisions, confidence, and actions are captured and correlated across systems and agents.

props.name: threat-framework
props.remarks: Provides AI-specific threat context for misuse, autonomous abuse, decision manipulation, and behavior obfuscation requiring observability.

props.name: ai-threat-class
props.remarks: Threats where AI actions, decisions, or delegation chains cannot be reliably reconstructed or attributed.

props.name: ai-threat-class
props.remarks: Threats arising when AI misuse, abuse, or emergent behavior is not detectable due to insufficient telemetry.

metadata.remarks: AI Telemetry and Observability defines how AI system behavior is made visible and auditable. Without this pattern, accountability, safe autonomy, incident response, red teaming, and trust enforcement for AI systems are not feasible.

components.title: Prompt and Context Logging
components.description: Capture of AI inputs, including prompts and injected context, with appropriate scope and privacy controls.

implemented-requirements.remarks: AI system prompts and external context inputs are logged in a manner that supports reconstruction, analysis, and policy enforcement.

components.title: Decision and Confidence Telemetry
components.description: Recording of AI-generated decisions, recommendations, confidence levels, and uncertainty signals.

implemented-requirements.remarks: AI decisions and confidence indicators are recorded to enable accountability, review, and incident analysis.

components.title: Tool and Action Tracking
components.description: Monitoring and logging of tools invoked and actions executed by AI or agentic systems.

implemented-requirements.remarks: All external tool invocations and consequential actions performed by AI systems are logged and attributable.

components.title: Cross-Agent Correlation
components.description: Correlation of telemetry across multiple AI systems and agents to preserve end-to-end traceability.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Telemetry from multiple AI agents and systems is correlated to reconstruct delegation chains and cascading behavior.
